title: Thinking on Building Trust
summary: Kahran and Divya unpack how trust gets built between people, between brands and customers, and inside teams — drawing a distinction between practical trust (can you do the thing) and emotional trust (will you have my back). They walk through hospitality examples (the W shipping a forgotten laptop to India, the Oberoi going beyond the brief) and how mistakes are often the most powerful trust-building moments.

intents.display: to think about how brands and people actually earn your trust
